description: One bug-bounty program by platform + handle: bounty range, status, and scope assets where the platform publishes them without a login. YesWeHack returns a full severity x asset-value reward table; HackerOne returns real scope but no numeric reward table (not exposed publicly); Bugcrowd returns neither (login-walled) and says so.

handle.description: The program's slug/handle on that platform, e.g. "security" on HackerOne or "cryptobox-bug-bounty" on YesWeHack.
